title: Beyond the 956: Sheila Mangubat, '90 Day Fiancé' star, dies at 35
excerpt: Sheila Mangubat, the reality star known for TLC's '90 Day Fiancé: Before the 90 Days,' has died at 35. Her former fiancé, David Dangerfield, announced her death on November 21, 2026, saying she died in the Philippines, days before her 36th birthday.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Sheila Mangubat, the reality television star known for TLC's 90 Day Fiancé: Before the 90 Days, has died at 35.

Mangubat died on Saturday, November 21, 2026, in the Philippines, just days before her 36th birthday.

Her former fiancé, David Dangerfield, announced her death in an Instagram post on Saturday, sharing the news from her family. “It breaks my heart to share the news from her family that Sheila passed away on Saturday in the Philippines,” he wrote. “I am devastated and still trying to process this loss. Please keep her son, her family, and me in your prayers.”

Mangubat, from Cebu, Philippines, was a partially deaf single mother. She met Dangerfield in 2021 in a Facebook group for deaf singles, and the two documented their long-distance romance and engagement on season six of 90 Day Fiancé: Before the 90 Days in 2023.

The couple split in October 2025 after K-1 visa issues, then rekindled their romance in June, according to TMZ.

Her brother Jonathan shared a video of her funeral online on Sunday, November 22, and her sister Grace wrote in a tribute on Facebook, “Rest in peace my beloved sister ... fly high my sister, we will miss you.”

No cause of death has been released. Mangubat is survived by her only son, Jhonreil.

Sources: People; TMZ; Page Six.
